caption:
This sentence has no real verb.

"The engineers, hoping to map the reef, using drones." Lift out the middle: "The engineers using drones" is a caption, not a sentence. Fix: used.

Comment if you spotted it.
tiktok_caption: Looks complete, but there's no real verb. Spot it?

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Every Sentence Needs a Main Verb
youtube.description: An -ing word can't be a sentence's main verb by itself. Read the subject and verb alone to check.
